text.body: piṇḍalakṣaṇam yamayuktavarṇapiṇḍo nibiḍo ayaḥ 1 piṇḍavadbhavati yathā rukkma śaggmāntaḥ 2 aghghniyāḥ tanamiccmiyacchmaśruṇaḥ parijjmā āṭṭṇāraḥ ātmanaḥ dadhnā pāppmā dabhbhno 3 ityādisparśāntasthā yogoviślathabandhastu dārupiṇḍasamaḥ 4 pā kathācidvasavaḥssaṃvatsaramukhthaṃ vajraḥ ityādiḥ 5 pa ayamoṣmottamayogaślathabandhastūlapiṇḍasamaḥ 6 ślathabandho yatra naṇau vakārapūrvau bhavettatra 7 ayamaḥ yamavarṇaśūnyaḥ yamūṣmottamānāṃ kramānmitho'nvayaḥ 8 sakūlapiṇḍa ayamaḥ baviśeṣaṇamayaḥ piṇḍādbhedajñāpanāya yathā 9 brahmavādinaḥ ahnāṃ aparāhṇe ślathabandho yathā 10 vibhūdāvunne 11 dadhikrāvivīṇṇaḥ 12 grāvīṇṇaḥ 13 pūrvokte dārupiṇḍe sparśasya pūrvatvaṃ vivakṣitam 14 atra tu vakārasya antasthāyāḥ pūrvatvamiti ślathabandhe viśeṣaḥ 15 ato'sya na dārupiṇḍe'ntarbhāvaḥ 16 badhnanti yathābhāraṃ trīṇasya saṃveṣṭyavāhakāḥ puruṣāḥ sayakāravarṇapiṇḍaṃ samuccare dvaidikantadvat 17 ayantrīṇabandhaḥ 18 yathā 19 prajananaṃ jyotiḥ abhyaśnute apvāyadhvaṃ yamyāsaṃ vivadānā 20 atra dārupiṇḍa eva yakārarūpāntasthāyāḥ sparśayoge tṛṇarajubaṃdhavat 21 uccarediti viśeṣaviddhyarthamayamāraṃbhaḥ 22 uttamaparo hakāro nāsikyaścaurasaśca bhavet 23 o aurasa evāntasthāyā paro naṇamaparo mahānādaḥ 24 atra pūrvārdhena turyavākyena ca mūlapiṇḍe viśeṣamāhasa yathā 25 śaradyaparāhṇe 26 ahnnāndīketuḥ brahmavādinaḥ tṛtīyapādena dārupiṇḍaviśeṣa uktaḥ 27 turyarcena ca dārupiṇḍamantasthairyuktamiti gautamokteḥ 28 ihāpi dārupiṇḍa eva 29 yathā mahyannamantāṃ kṛśiṣanduhrehlādayate 30 ahvādhāḥ 31 pa antasthoktamayogenā utsṛjyoghrāṇajo hakārasya vāyuḥ parayodi syāt tatra tu pṛthaguccārayedenaṃ hakārasyāntasthoktamebhyaḥ pūrvatve hakārasya vāyuḥ kaṇḍadeśe na tyājyaḥ 32 kiṃ tu urasaiva hakāra uccāraṇīyya ityarthaḥ tathā ca śikṣā vacanam 33 hakāraṃ paṃcamairyuktamantasthābhiśca saṃyutam urasyantaṃ vijānīyātkaṇṭhyamāhurasaṃyutam | iti 34 hakārasya paratve'nupūrvairantasthoktamaihikāramaśliṣṭamuccaret 35 yathā caturhotṛṇāṃ malyahā pratyandīhotāraṃ etān homān 36 mātṛkāyāmapyasaṃpūrṇam 37
